business_summary: Guangdong Adway Construction (Group) Holdings Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of interior and exterior building decoration and design services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers building decoration services, such as building decoration, electrical and mechanical installation, curtain wall engineering works, and fire safety engineering works. Its projects cover various building and properties, including commercial buildings, office buildings, industrial buildings, residential buildings, and public buildings and infrastructures, as well as hotels. In addition, the company is involved in the industrial and commercial investment; supply chain management; construction material import and export activities; development and construction of industrial park; and design and sale of mobile and fixed furniture suitable for the use of construction decoration works and soft decoration product. It serves public and private clients, such as state-owned enterprises, government departments and institutions, listed companies, foreign-funded enterprises, property developers, and property management companies. Guangdong Adway Construction (Group) Holdings Company Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
